reviews.title: Great Game
reviews.text: This game is very good, from the animations to the hero variety to the scaling, everything in this game is super well put together. A couple of the pictures on the Apple store are no longer accurate as they’ve been updated within the game, specifically the equipment screen now has multiple armor slots and the Artifact screen (showing Annabel) now has many more artifacts to gain. There is also a very nice Discord server created by the Dev so players can get their own input into the game, as well as talk with others. The Dev is also quite active, releasing minor fixes regularly and large updates somewhat frequently.- Now to address some of the bad reviews, players who’ve had these issues clearly HAVE NOT SOUGHT OUT HELP FROM THE DEV, we have an open discord with active members, if there’s anything you need you can always join and ask. Secondly, ads are in every mobile game these days, iap’

reviews.title: Very Swag
reviews.text: I don’t call mobile games fun, but this is actually fun. The leveling system is fantastic, the character models, the almost synchronized look to how the heroes fight, all of those this make this game splendid. Most of all I love the lack of ads in this game, like you might get an ad once every like hour or something. Oh also the combining of a cleric, paladin, bard, and barbarian is a fantastic quartet. Healing and dealing insane damage at the same time. But that is only like a handful of the cool combinations that you can make. You go for crit build and effectively mop the floor with bosses. You could go for a ranged build to keep your characters safe. I could spend all day explaining this to you but frankly you should see for yourself. You should get this game. It takes maybe 2 minutes to get the hang of. After that smooth sailing. My only regret is that I can not give this more than 5

reviews.title: Micro-transaction made the game unplayable
reviews.text: I almost never leave reviews, but this one really put a damper on my mood.  This game isn’t terrible, after playing it for a few hours I noticed it was a slow grind that I had to pay attention to. I saw that they had a bundle for $4 that allowed for your team to repeat the dungeon automatically. I purchased this package, but instead of adding to the quality of life.... it broke the game. Now any time my team dies, if I press “restart” the game goes to a black screen with a banner ad and does not leave the menu. If i let the automatic restart go off.... it does the same thing. I have to quit the app and restart it every time I want to start a new dungeon crawl.  So, not only did the bundle not do what it said it was going to..... it made it so I had to purchase new heroes every single time.... before I made the purchase, it let me restart with the same set up. So essentially I paid money

reviews.title: Great Game
reviews.text: I loved this game, enough to keep my phone running all night to grind some more resources. It is simple, fun, and makes you wanting to come back for more. However, the latest update does unfortunately dampen the mood when playing. With everything feeling several times more expensive than they were a minute ago, I have since lost much of my previous interest. I can understand why the developers might choose to make everything feel more expensive, it could be due to the fact that it was almost all too easy to significant progress, and unless you like upgrading stuff for no other reason than to upgrade stuff, you will quickly get to a point where you are no longer progressing much. With that being said, I feel hindered in making the progress I was making in this game and no longer interested in spending any significant amount of time on this game moving forward. I will keep this game around

reviews.title: Good game
reviews.text: This game is a pretty good game. It may resemble the Soda Dungeon games but there are things that make them different. I’ll be honest though, I’d like to see some quality of life improvements. One specific request I have is the ability to auto equip armor and weapons onto the heroes we hire. So like if I hire a knight and a wizard and I have two helmets, I’d like for the game to automatically equip the helmets onto said heroes. The pop ads aren’t too bad so that’s good and there are in app purchases but I can tell you that you DO NOT need to spend money to progress. The game is a bit grindy but I like that aspect in games. The whole xp and gold factory is also a nice touch. So to wrap this all up in a brief summary, I’d like to see that aforementioned quality of life improvement but other then that this is a great game! Thank you for your time.

reviews.title: A good game with a whole lot of potential
reviews.text: This game has a very interesting concept, and is genuinely quite fun to play. The pixel dungeon crawler style is nothing new, but the rapid action and unique characters makes it fun and interesting. The way you get stronger and progress feels like it’s got a good pace to it, and the fact that you don’t have to pay to unlock the content if you grind enough makes this game very appealing. That said, the lack of change in stages and the general dryness of the lobby area is off putting. If there was a bit more variation and if the lobby was a bit more interesting, I would have given this game 5 stars. Overall, this game is quite well done and I can see it gaining a lot of momentum in the future if the developers put some time into what the player base recommends them to. So, like I said in the title, this is a good game that has a whole lot of potential for the future.

reviews.title: Developer is very active. Give support to this game.
reviews.text:
Fans of Soda Dungeon series will love this game. I think Dunidle is actually better than SD2. You get more gear and loot, more options to build a party, more character types, lots of enemy types, good music, etc. I don’t know what it is about this particular idle RPG, but I can’t put it down. Do yourself a favor and unlock at least the ad free version of the game. Throw this developer some support. You can tell he or she really enjoys creating a fun and addicting game. Tons of love and attention went into the creation of this game.

I had an issue with this game crashing after one of the ios updates. Developer updated the game promptly. This is what the App Store needs. Quality games with developers that care. Give this person support and get this game. AAA+ game and support.

reviews.title: Fantastic Game
reviews.text: This has everything I want in a mobile game it has minimal ads and it’s engaging but it’s also something you don’t have to pay much attention to so it allows you to do other things while playing it. I love the pixel art and simple animations and the progression is paced very well. I only have 2 things I’d like changed about this game 1. The pop up ads you occasionally get on the bottom of your screen get in the way of going back to the home area so maybe move those ads up after each dungeon run 2. This relates to ads again, I’d like a Feature for maybe $5 to remove all ads permanently there aren’t very many ads but that is still something I’d like but besides that it’s a great game.

reviews.title: Lots of Bugs
reviews.text:
Great gameplay and progression. There’s enough grinding to make the accomplishment of getting to the next world enjoyable but not so much that it becomes boring. There are plenty of characters to choose from with unique abilities and interesting mechanics and accessories that make it feel like you really do get to choose your team and experiment with a lot of different options.

However, there are a LOT of bugs. Buying premium skins ruins your inventory, runes seem to disappear occasionally, abilities will trigger after a hero is dead which means per a stuck in a level until you restart the app, etc. I tried to look past the bugs for a while but it eventually became literally unplayable even with an uninstall and reinstall of the app. I’d still recommend it, just don’t expect to be able to finish the game... the BUGS will stop you.

reviews.title: More idle than afk
reviews.text: I mean this in a sense that you have to play the game more than you can just open it once and let it generate currency. You have the option to do that buuuuuuut you gotta progress to do it. Luckily this game makes you want to progress, with lots of classes, characters, and a multitude of ways to power your character, there’s not much more you could ask except for being able to be in contract with the dev and get free stuff. But wait, you can?! WHAAAAAT?! That’s right, the creator even has a discord for the game solely for the purpose of having the community more easily help one another. Plus there’s give aways in the discord. All in all a great game to at least try

reviews.title: Fun Game, Awesome Developers!
reviews.text:
This is a wonderful game, and the dev team should be proud. In addition to fun, customizable gameplay, the developers are very interactive with the player base. They are even nice enough to directly message players via discord to send us redeemable codes for in-game currency. 

As far as gameplay, there are tons of classes (or heroes) to choose from. You can level them up and earn skill points to upgrade unique skills. Personally, Necromancer is my favorite. Collecting loot is super fun, and the RNG stats provide a lot of replay value.

The art style is very appealing to me, as it creates a dark, cult-y atmosphere. It definitely fits with the other aspects of the game and really ties everything together.

There isn’t much dialogue as of now, but the dialogue that currently exists is definitely humorous. I enjoy it, and it makes the game feel less “lonely.”

Overall, this game is one of m

reviews.title: Enjoyable, even when hacked
reviews.text: The save file is just a .txt file that needs to be ‘gunzipped’. From there it is a raw json file and easily modified, giving oneself gold, gems, unlocks… you’d think it would take all of the fun out of it, but it doesn’t. I would say that having combed through every line of the export, the game is very well managed on the back end and my hat goes off to the dev(s). Further, there is a lot of detail hiding in there that you don’t typically associate with the simplicity of an 8-bit visualization. Cool game, cool implementation, if you played legit (unlike me) you could probably play constantly for a year and still not max everything out.

reviews.title: This game is great! check it out
reviews.text: This game is all you expect in an auto play and more, there are little to no pop up ads, if you join the discord you get free rewards, and at the later parts of the game you can get an upgrade that allows you to get the paid currency by exchanging the free currency! i’ve always wanted something like that in a game and i’m glad the developer added that. While there may be a few bugs here and there if you join the discord server there is a channel where you can report these bugs but you also have to remember that this game is made and operated by one guy

reviews.title: Plz help- updated
reviews.text:
I want to get into this game, but for the life of me I can’t remember how to equip new weapons… please help! There’s not option anywhere in the narrator screen and when I click on people, it’s either yey or ney for their portal placement!

Update:
Thx for the help! Definitely forgot that equip gear was only possible when selected for portal. 

So onto some comments. I love this game! I have been playing for over a week now and am totally into it. So far, the only thing I’d say is I’d be looking forward to new skins, maybe some new classes, and most definitely more environment variants. I feel they’re just a bit too basic right now. Perhaps some more detail, more plants, more differences between rooms. It would also be cool if a special dungeon/door spawned in a random room for an option to unlock of a piece of gear or something. Trying to think of ways to keep levels fresh. Anyway, great

reviews.title: Casual game that you can fit into a busy day
reviews.text: The classes and progression is really great, and the game is quite good for being made by a single person. They have also set up a very convenient discord for their game and there’s lots of giveaways for premium currency. You definitely don’t have to spend any money to get to endgame, and content seems to come out regularly. Also once you get things moving along, you can start to idle and have the game running itself for a bit while you do something else. I’ll be in class, playing a pc game, or eating and I can play this on the side

reviews.title: So amazing!
reviews.text: This is honestly one of the greatest idle games I’ve ever played, so much actually I’ve had it on three different phones over the course of like 5 years. You don’t have to stay on it for super long or buy premium things with real money to get ahead. It’s just as an idle game should be, get stuck or want to progress faster? Leave your phone not running the game for 4-5 hours and when you open it back up you can get loads of stuff. Overall it’s a 10/10 if I could give 10 stars I would.

reviews.title: I want No Ads without all the bonuses
reviews.text:
I just want to get the No Ads but without all those bonuses you get for paying. It’s unfortunate because I want to play the game absolutely normally but pay for the option of simply having No Ads but I can’t do that without getting several P2W bonuses that’ll make the game easier.

I don’t want the game easier, I just want no ads. Make a cheaper option like $4.99 for ONLY No Ads and not anything else.

I really like the game but a 2-Star feels necessary because of this weird choice of having No Ads be tied to so many other bonuses.

reviews.title: Best idle game
reviews.text: I love this game it has good balance and a lot of original content for everyone to enjoy! Each member has there own special way of helping in combat. They even have there own weapons and attacks which I find great. Bosses are somewhat harder but that’s the point and you have to build up your characters as well as your strategy. 10/10 I’ve played a lot of incremental and idle games and this one is pretty good it has good gameplay good balance and even a good way for it to still be an idle game. Keep up the good work!!❤️

reviews.title: So close yet so far
reviews.text: Pretty decent game until you find out it tracks you without your consent. Had a nice run recently with 2 druids that soft locked the game. Despite them claiming this is (fixed). I gathered some experience from meditation and it resulted in lowering my levels. Ai pathfinding is a joke as your units will sit in an aoe dot instead of moving. Banner ad taking up half of the menu button to advance, pretty much baiting you to click on it. Seriously, all you had to do was not mess up, and you took the low road every time. Cannot recommended this game. I’m on iPhone SE, to be fair my screen is very small. However it’s not an issue with any other games

reviews.title: More to come?
reviews.text: This game is a fun grind where you can specialize your champions to progress further and further through increasing boss stages. The part that is rough is once you beat the game there is nothing to work towards no missions to do daily or special resources to farm just grinding the last 100 levels on repeat to build up you in game currencies. If they want to make people stay they would probably need to implement something Like limited time bosses or special maps to try and clear, just anything to make you feel the urge to come back is what they are really missing.

reviews.title: Entertaining
reviews.text:
This is a fun game/simulator to throw on in the background while watching tv, etc. It’s perfect for people who want more than just a pure idle game, but who don’t want to spend the time and energy manually crawling dungeons.

Suggestion: 

* It’s a bit tedious looking through the ring inventory (you have to go through each category of ring). It would be nice to show all the rings on the same page and then be able to filter them.

reviews.title: Game is ok
reviews.text:
The game is simple and fun, nothing great or new but fun enough, and for a single dev it’s impressive. 

I would give it 5 stars, but it has a very annoying feature that makes me give it 3. You select your chars from a random roll of characters.  That’s fine, other games have done that, but they all have some unlock to make it less annoying as you progress.  

Unless I’m missing something this game does not and when you have all the characters unlocked it can take 1-2 minutes of clicking reroll to get the characters you want.  This serves no purpose but to be annoying, and there’s no reason there should not be a fix for this.  Ability to save your team or atleast deselect the characters you don’t want would fix this easy.

There’s a purchase that unlocks all the chars perm and I bought it to support the game, but now it’s just an annoyance that I wish I would not have payed money for.

reviews.title: So much potential!
reviews.text: The current version of this game is very fun.  The levels are great. The classes are simple and easy to understand. The synergy of character choice and leveling is interesting. And the way things are set up it can only get better. The game makes me excited for updates not upset that this or that is too hard or not included. The developer is accessible via discord- reasonably, mind you- and keeps things fresh with giveaways and the like. I can’t wait to see how this game grows.

reviews.title: I love this game!!!
reviews.text: I have been playing this game for a couple months now I have super bad adhd so I download a few games a day if I’m bored lol. Anyway I decided today I would buy something for it so I did and it didn’t work I message the discord 5 min I got a response six hours my problem was fixed I’m definitely playing this for a while. Keep doing what you’re doing 5 stars is not enough you guys deserve at least ten for this game.

reviews.title: Great idle game
reviews.text: This game is a great way to spend time! It’s fun & easy to learn. The RPG elements are there and they give enough depth to keep you coming back without alienating non-RPG gamers. In addition, the support I received when I had an issue with a purchase was fast, friendly, and worked perfectly. In fact, it was the most friendly support I’ve ever received for a mobile game. Give this game a try, you won’t regret it!

reviews.title: Well thought out game with great community.
reviews.text: I’d just like to say that I really like the way you interact with your community to make a more optimized game for the actual customers. I think there’s no better way of improving an game then looking for feedback like you are. Overall just a fun game not anything crazy but there’s only so much you can do with a mobile game. Overall it’s a grind but an enjoyable one.

reviews.title: Retro look, but modern RPG flair.
reviews.text: Hello, are you a nerd? Do you like table top RPGs? Do you like fantasy dungeon crawling mayhem? Then you most likely you will enjoy this game. Lots of classes, gear and grinding. It’s a idle game and you don’t control your characters but you customize them, set your party up, level and equip to make some fun strategies. Devs are friendly and just a post away on their discord. Lots of fun, and it can just run while you chill.

reviews.title: Hidden Gem
reviews.text:
Such a great game! The devs are very open to communication with the discord community, that’s just the cherry on top. The meat and potatoes of the game is wonderful, sure it does require a bit of grinding but you can do it while you’re at work or even sleeping. Everything can be acquired through grinding in the game even the premium currency which a lot of games don’t.

So now About the game. You pick a class (barb, knight, healer, mage etc….) you grind into the dungeon, you get lots, you slay monsters and bosses. Upgrade your items, heroes then go deeper into the dungeon.. but it’s so much fun.

Keep up the good work devs!

reviews.title: Fun class combinations
reviews.text: The game offers many different ways to progress whether by leveling base weapons, characters, or class combinations or even just leaving levels. The higher end classes are also easy to obtain f2p and even if you spend, are very cheap as well. The stats make for a fun numbers game, plus many classes can easily boost those stats higher. As an idle game, you can play for just a bit a day and still enjoy

reviews.title: The best of its kind
reviews.text:
I’ve tried a lot of idle games, but this is by far the best, graphics aside. Once you understand the mechanics and gameplay, its depth is what sets it above the rest. Skill runes, item system, and class diversity is all very fun to improve and explore. 

It also helps that the developer is so involved. I emailed them with a bug and it was fixed for me by the next day!

reviews.title: The game
reviews.text: I very much enjoy the immersion into the small conversation into the beginning of it. I like how even though it’s 2D, it still has some good detail and good content. And on top of that, the floor and leveling system is always been a fun thing for me. I have always enjoyed customization and gothic games that are dungeon based. I would totally recommend this to friends. 10/10

reviews.title: Great idle RPG
reviews.text: This is a great game. If you enjoy class building, dungeoning and gear hunting, you will love this game. Animations are fun but the best part of the game is the detailed customization of characters you can get into. Build your team and conquer the dungeons to get better gear. Very balanced, great scaling and an active Discord community. The game developer (I think it’s just one dude) is very responsive if there are any issues. Easily a 5-star game.

reviews.title: Great, but found a bug
reviews.text: Recently started playing and it’s super fun, a perfect mix of interaction and idle for a phone game. My game bugged out, though, to where the “Auto Farm” option in Free Items does not work when I tap on Activate. It shows that it’s off, but it actually is always on. Thus, I’m getting ads and having dungeons restart when I don’t want to. The feature is nice but I want to be able to toggle it again.

reviews.title: Great mobile game.
reviews.text: My one petty annoyance is how sometimes when your units have their turn to move, they can’t just stay still. This makes it so they have to take a step back because they are stuck against another unit, which costs a turn to attack. I understand this game aims for simplicity, but I would enjoy a little bit more variety in the size and complexity of each floor.

reviews.title: Great game, fun concept!
reviews.text:
So while there’s a not a “main character” per se, it’s equipment and stats automatically transfer over which is nice if you’re not the type to worry about gear management. It also lets you experiment with the randomly generated class options, and if you’re not satisfied with your selections, for a small fee of in game currency you can re-roll your choices. 

All in all, simple and fun.

reviews.title: Latest update
reviews.text: Left a 3 start review 7 days into playing because I didn’t like a change made on an update. Still don’t like the change but I am now 17 days into the game and couldn’t be happier.  You got to grind. Period.  But anything and everything you need is obtainable for free. Give it a go. Best Idle RPG I have came across in a long time

reviews.title: I can’t put it down!
reviews.text: This game is actually incredible and I cant stop playing! I cant wait to see the future of this game. One of the better and more innovative idle games that i’ve ever played (and I’ve played them all) All I can say is that I hope the developer keeps updating and releasing more content in the future!

reviews.title: Trent
reviews.text: In my opinion after playing it for a few days it’s really fun and interesting, but I don’t like that I have to close and reopen the app sometimes, I would be fine with this if it didn’t make it so it doesn’t save some of my progress a few seconds ago.

reviews.title: What happened?
reviews.text: Going through the tutorial I was really enjoying the game and while doing it when I recruited other heroes to my party (all knights) they all had the same equipment, but then suddenly only 1 knight has the equipment and the rest are completely useless. I just want to know which version is intentional, either way really enjoying the game so far.

reviews.title: Great Game
reviews.text: Just the type of idle rpg I was looking for and yes I bought the 12 dollar pack for no ads and it was well worth it. It’s grindy and deep. Not hard to get gold and unlock hero’s still haven’t gotten super far but, auto farming and power save mode. Well worth the upgrade for no ads. Not a paid promotion

reviews.title: Bug?
reviews.text:
The Fastest Man Alive buff is supposed to increase gamespeed by 1000%? Well it does work well. It only takes effect once the floor is cleared and your team is advancing to the next floor. This becomes useless and a waste of 5mil gold if you already have the Warp ability, which instantly warps you to the next floor anyways.

Please fix this by actually increasing the gamespeed, otherwise it does absolutely nothing. Or, remove it.

reviews.title: Amazing game and keeps improving!
reviews.text: This game is super fun sure it’s a little slow to level up at first but once you get the hang of it and get some gear you will be invincible. The designers are working on new skill systems as well to make it more in depth and on top of the the game designers ACTUALLY LISTEN TO SUGGESTIONS AND RESPONS! I give this 5 stars 10/10 bravo!

reviews.title: Fun to play
reviews.text: This game provides simple yet interesting mechanics that allow for a dynamic idle gaming experience without monopolizing your time or focus. While not fully necessary, the only thing I would add atm is a team upgrade that allows for the player to run dungeons behind the scenes when the user is afk in another app. Great game. Can’t wait to see how it evolves.

reviews.title: This game
reviews.text: This game is truly takes the cake as one of the best mobile games out there right now. Unlike all of the other stick figure idle games Thies developers truly care about there game and want it to be the best it can be over this game is amazing and I think every one should play it.

reviews.title: Easy to understand and fun to play
reviews.text: This game perfectly combines dungeon crawlers and idle games. The level system is one I haven’t seen before, and I think it’s great. The characters look really cool and the variations you could have for your four person team are very diverse. From wizards to barbarians this game really has it all.

reviews.title: Fun Idle RPG
reviews.text: This is a solid idle RPG if you like the dungeon grinding. My biggest issue is that as you get deeper in the game, the amount of random ads increases quite a bit. I'm fine with the requested ads for bonuses but it starts to get quite annoying and discouraging as you get hit constantly with random ads (like cycling refresh of availabile characters)

reviews.title: Simple yet fun way to pass time
reviews.text: This game is rather simplistic, and does not require much work at all. You can achieve everything you need in a decent amount of time. It’s a great way to pass some time if you get bored. Even though it is simplistic though, there is still a strategic side behind it.

reviews.title: Good game
reviews.text: I highly enjoy this game. The graphics are good and the game is fun. There are a lot of stats to look at, dungeons to go further down into, items with varying stats so you’re fishing for that well rolled item, and different characters with unique abilities. I like dungeon crawlers and this hits the nail for me.

reviews.title: Broken
reviews.text: Was having fun for a little but the game bugged out and will only let me put abilities on the starting sword, no other swords and no abilities for any other classes, turned basically all the team building into just spam knights. Tried tiers of weapons, new classes, different ability types, no luck. Only the starting sword will take any runes, clicking the rune slot doesn’t work on any other weapon, it acts like a painted square without any object implemented on the backend, no menu or anything. Bummer

reviews.title: Decent, but a battery killer
reviews.text:
I enjoy the game. The progression pace is reasonable, neither to fast nor too slow.

However, the game has to be running in the foreground at all times, so really chews through battery life.

I’d request an actual offline idle mode, and a better item filter/comparison menu.

reviews.title: Addicting and in depth!
reviews.text: I love how in depth the character build is in this game. I’ve had it for over a week now and I love the different weapons and rings you can put on each hero. The fact that each hero requires a different weapon is wonderful as well. It keeps it from becoming a stale and repetitive game!

reviews.title: Fun and addictive game!
reviews.text: This is an absolutely fun dungeon crawler! The gameplay is easy to pickup, making it appealable to the casual player, but comes with an almost infinite variety of character and team customizations that will appeal to most in-depth gamers! Definitely a keeper! Awesome job dev! Keep up the good work!

reviews.title: Restoring Purchases
reviews.text: Don’t get me wrong, the game is great but the restore purchases option isn’t working for me anymore with this latest install.  No more 2x speed and no more ad free bonuses that were already acquired.  Not sure what’s going on but the restores used to work after reinstalling the game.

reviews.title: Great game
reviews.text: Love the 8-bit graphics. Gives it that old school retro feel. The discord communication is great. Game runs very smoothly and is very easy to get a hang of. The community is definitely present to help you out if needed. Overall a great game and I look forward to its development over time!

reviews.title: Dungeon Floors
reviews.text:
I love this game and paid to unlock everything. The game really comes alive and I’m happy with my purchase.

My only complaint is that I wish it was less cumbersome to go back to floor 1. I like to farm crystals and it’s a real chore to go back 400 floors to get to the first floor. Please give us an option to make it easier to go back large amounts of dungeon floors! 🙏

reviews.title: Alright game
reviews.text: This game is fun don’t get me wrong, but once you get to certain points it feels so slow, and it’s repetitive like you aren’t gaining anything, there’s no rewarding factors, I’ve gotten everything the best there is and I’m waiting for an update, there is almost too many bugs for the game to be out right now, and I feel like if they put more work into the game it could be fantastic

reviews.title: The game is enjoyable, BUT... <EDIT>
reviews.text:
Edit: All fixed now, back to loving the game! Thanks dev’s, y’all on the ball! :)

All the purchasable items come up as “unavailable for purchase” so until that is addressed, I’m giving it one star. Once I can pay to get rid of the ad’s, I’ll update this review.

reviews.title: Why is it still on the Mac store then?
reviews.text:
Same issue, MBP 2020, so not old hardware. App. listed as OSX/Mac compatible. But as other reviews state, game window is too large to fix on the screen, so the game is literally unplayable. Window is unable to be scaled or resized in any way.

Dev's apologies are all well and good, but if you can't support your software and it doesn't function in any meaningful way, remove it from the store, stop false advertising. It really is a shame.

reviews.title: Fun but..
reviews.text:
So the game was fun. 

However, there a quite of game killing bugs. The tutorial is bugged and locks the game up. Finally I thought to skip it and then I was able to continue. Spending 200 diamonds and only get a level 14 weapon. 

Despite all the bugs I thought I would push through and complete the game in a few days. Now there is nothing left to do. 

Some of the in game perks are almost unattainable. Took three days of grinding after I beat he game to get the last perk. 

For an afk game the only way to progress is to log in and watch. So while you are not doing anything you are not truly afk. 

I do feel this game could have a lot of potential but it does not seem as they are doing any content updates.
